# Two vendor answers

> **Constructed** for this course. TicketHarbor and MinuteMoss are made up; no real company is meant. Their answers are written to show common gaps. Read them against the [vendor questionnaire](../templates/vendor-questionnaire.md).

## TicketHarbor: Helpdesk tool with an AI reply suggester

Used by Larkfield for: Reply suggester in the helpdesk tool (card S6).

| # | Topic | The vendor's answer |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Data use | We use customer content to improve our AI features. Customers may opt out by e-mail to our support team. |
| 2 | Training | Yes, by default (opt-out by e-mail). |
| 3 | Retention | As long as the account is active. |
| 4 | Sub-processors | Listed on our website. |
| 5 | Location | United States and European Union. |
| 6 | Security | An independent security audit report is available under a confidentiality agreement. |
| 7 | Incident notice | We notify customers without undue delay. |
| 8 | Model information | We use leading AI models. |
| 9 | Human oversight | Agents always review suggestions. |
| 10 | Exit | Export of tickets in 30 days after the end of the contract; AI settings are not exported. |

## MinuteMoss: Meeting recorder and note writer

Used by Larkfield for: Meeting-notes tool (card S7).

| # | Topic | The vendor's answer |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Data use | Recordings and notes are used only to provide the service to you. |
| 2 | Training | No. We do not train models on customer content. |
| 3 | Retention | Recordings are deleted after 30 days; notes are kept until you delete them. |
| 4 | Sub-processors | Hosting: a cloud provider in Canada. AI: a large model provider, under a contract that forbids training on your data. |
| 5 | Location | Canada. |
| 6 | Security | Encryption in transit and at rest; single sign-on. |
| 7 | Incident notice | Within 72 hours of confirming an incident. |
| 8 | Model information | Notes are written by a large language model; they can contain mistakes. |
| 9 | Human oversight | Not stated. |
| 10 | Exit | Delete all content on request, within 30 days; export of notes at any time. |

## Your task

For each vendor: mark every answer that is missing, vague or not in the contract. Then decide: switch on, switch on with conditions (which ones, and who checks them), or keep off. Give your reasons.

The third bought feature, the invoice reader in the accounting tool of LedgerFern, has no answers at all: nobody sent the questionnaire.
